# A stream opened on attempt one must finish there, without following attempt two.
server start
retry-task task.json follow 1
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-follow
job-id JOB
await-file first
skygo jobs logs $JOB --follow &
await-stdout 'attempt one'
cp release.txt release
wait
stdout '^attempt one\n$'
! stdout 'attempt two'
await-state $JOB succeeded
history failed succeeded
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^attempt two\n$'
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
stdout '"attempt_id":'
! stdout 'attempt two'
server stop
! stderr .
-- release.txt --
release
